title: Design: A/P Detail narrower than 1440 px scrolls under the pinned column
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin user (the "Admin" role).
  • Have open documents in these reports at two locations, so the Location column shows.
  • Use a desktop browser window 1280 px wide.
  • Open A/P Detail (Reports, then "A/P Aging Detail" under ACCOUNTS PAYABLE in the left menu).
  • Leave the report with every bucket expanded.
custom_steps:
1. Look at the right edge of the table.
  2. Scroll the table sideways to the right.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • "Open Balance" is pinned to the right edge and the table has a sideways scroll.

Step 2:

  • The other columns slide under the pinned "Open Balance" column, nothing overlaps.
  • The bucket labels stay visible at the left.
  • The title row stays on one line.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "A/R and A/P Report Sorting, Export and Location Filter", Confluence 947650561, version 9 (23 Oct 2026, Chris Ward), read 26 Oct 2026 · Epic SV-11315, story SV-11534 (Story 4, Collapse all, Expand all and pinned group rows), story SV-11538 (Story 8, Report descriptions and layout)

  • S8-R3: “The headline column (Open Balance; Total on the Summaries) is pinned to the right edge and bold on the header, every row, every expanded row and the Totals row, as on Sales By Customer. At 1440 pixels wide every column of all six reports is visible without scrolling sideways: the customer or vendor name and Transaction Type wrap long values onto a second line, Location wraps only on A/P Detail (nine columns), column headings never wrap, and money, date and number columns never wrap. Narrower than 1440 pixels, the table scrolls sideways under the pinned column.”
  • S4-R7: “When the table scrolls sideways, each group row's label stays visible at the left.”

The build is not yet available to check this case against.

References from Design

Design canvas "A/R and A/P Report Sorting" (https://claude.ai/artifact/BRYCdjKwGRSgGPC9xxkgF4), read 22 Oct 2026: page 6 "Descriptions and pinned column" (board Layout.dc.html). The design pictures 1440 px only (all columns fit); narrower windows are not drawn. The pictures show the pinned, bold Open Balance.

  • ar-ap-p6-same-dark-2.png: figure "Same, dark" (This build (after)), board "6. Report descriptions and the pinned headline column"
  • ar-ap-p6-a-p-detail-scrolled-sideways-light.png: figure "A/P Detail scrolled sideways, light" (Production (before)), board "6. Report descriptions and the pinned headline column" (today's look, for comparison only)

  • "The headline column (Open Balance; Total on the Summaries) is bold and pinned right; the group label stays at the left. S8-R3, S8-R4, S4-R7." (caption of "Open Balance pinned, light")
  • "Pinned cells and links use the native colors in dark mode. S8-R3, S7-R7." (caption of "Same, dark")
  • "No description anywhere; no column stays in place." (caption of "A/P Detail scrolled sideways, light")
